author: hsliuustc0106
body: With `--text-encoder-tp-size 2` on four ranks, ranks 2 and 3 abort here. Every process constructs `GroupCoordinator(group_ranks=[[0, 1]])`, but that class asserts that the current rank belongs to one of its groups. Please create the groups collectively while returning a non-member-safe handle outside the encoder subset, and add an `N < world_size` multiprocess test.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: Ring attention does not preserve this packed padding boundary. H3 encodes padding as a second document in `cu_seqlens`, but the Ring path ignores both the packed metadata and `attn_mask`, so real tokens attend padding rows, which can become nonzero after AdaLN. Please reject Ring/hybrid Ring for H3 until the Ring kernel honors packed boundaries, or add packed-aware Ring plus a multi-rank parity test.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: `loaded.add(param_name)` marks a fused QKV or gate/up parameter complete after any one source shard is loaded. These parameters start as `torch.empty`, missing entries only warn below, and the pipeline later reports every eager encoder parameter as loaded. Please track required shard IDs and raise unless every retained parameter and fused slice was loaded.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: These repeated uploads have no count, per-file, or aggregate byte limit; the loop copies every file to `/tmp` before model validation. Multipart parsing does not cap file contents, so one request can exhaust disk. Please enforce limits while streaming, clean up on breach, and return 413.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: This only rejects image/video conflicts. `input_references` plus `audio_reference`, or an explicit `task=t2va/fl2va`, is persisted and accepted before MiniMax rejects it inside the engine; sync returns 500 and async creates a failed job. Please validate the task/source matrix here and return 400 before persisting files.

author: mglyn
body:
It looks like `condition_proj` and RoPE are also loop-invariant.

A related opportunity might be projecting the timesteps to AdaLN. Although their outputs change with the steps, they only depend on a limited sigma schedule, so in theory, you could use a model-level lookup table shared across requests. This might save `24.29 GiB` of BF16 AdaLN weights.
